streetview._note: Google Street View Static API slot. Set enabled=true and add a key (needs owner approval: Google Cloud account + card) to show Street View where no official photo exists.

deal_check._note: Deal Check grade thresholds. ratio = price / official value. Ohio price = published minimum/opening bid, value = county auditor market value if matched, else sheriff appraisal. NJ price = published approx. judgment/upset amount (what the lender is owed; the lender usually bids up to this), value = MOD-IV net assessed value (town assessment ratios vary). PA price = published minimum bid (Philadelphia tax sales) else the debt amount the Sheriff publishes; value = Philadelphia OPA market value or Montgomery County assessed value (1996 base year). Same thresholds as NJ. Not financial advice.
